blocks.content: Suppose we have the following unsorted vector.
Here's how we can use quick sort to sort this vector.
There are several variations of quick sort depending on what element is selected as the pivot.

items: Any random element from the vector

blocks.content: It is important to pick a good pivot element for the fast implementation of quick sort.
Here, we'll select the last element as our pivot element:

blocks.alt: Select the Last Element as the Pivot

blocks.content: The elements that are smaller than the pivot are put on the left, and the elements larger than the pivot are put on the right.
The vector is now divided into two halves:

items: one with elements less than the pivot
and another with elements greater than the pivot

blocks.content: Then we choose the pivot elements for both the left and right subvectors and repeat step 2.
When we have divided the vectors enough times so that each subvector only contains one element, then the elements will be in sorted order.
